about: Operative tier table for scripts/select-tier.py (test-suite restructure, 2026-11-09; amended 2026-11-09, Andrew approved). tests/TIER-MAP.md is the human document; THIS file is the machine copy the workflow reads. Keep the two in step: a change here without the doc, or the reverse, is drift. Precedence: tier C beats B beats A; a change touching several families runs the union of their drives; quarantined drives (tests/quarantine.json) are removed from tier A and B sets. Path entries ending in / are directory prefixes; tier_a_suffixes match file suffixes. Amendment: drive files (tests/browser/drive*.mjs) never escalate - they ride along with the app change's tier (a drives-only change is Tier B, running the touched drives); the test machinery (test_machinery_paths, glob: entries are fnmatch patterns) is Tier C on its own; generated outputs (generated_outputs) never classify - build-and-test proves them byte-equal to their sources, so the sources alone carry the tier; parts/brand-snow.js is a Tier A visual path (the snow layer, split out of parts/create-save.js by the amendment).
